sentences.text: A volcano is an opening in Earth's crust where hot rock from underground can reach the surface.
Melted rock under the ground is called magma.
When magma comes out onto the surface, it is called lava.
Some volcanoes erupt with ash, gas, and a loud blast.
Others leak lava more quietly and build wide, gentle slopes over many years.
Not every mountain is a volcano. A volcano is built by material that erupted.
Rock that cools from lava can look dark and full of tiny holes left by gas bubbles.
A volcano that has not erupted for a long time may be called dormant, which means sleeping, not gone.
A volcano that scientists do not expect to erupt again may be called extinct.
People watch volcanoes with tools that measure shaking, gases, and changes in the ground.
Those clues can sometimes warn a town before an eruption.
Lava is hot enough to burn trees and buildings, so the safe choice is to leave when experts say to go.

questions.prompt: What is this passage mostly about?

choices.text: What volcanoes are, and how people watch them
How to cook food over any mountain
Why every hill is ready to erupt
How gas bubbles are used as toys

questions.explanation: The passage defines magma and lava, contrasts quiet and explosive eruptions, and explains warning tools. Together, that is the main idea.

questions.prompt: A dormant volcano is one that is what?

choices.text: Erupting loudly at this very moment
Sleeping, not erupting for a long time, but not necessarily gone
Made only of ice and snow
Impossible to see on a map

questions.explanation: The passage says dormant means sleeping, not gone. It is different from extinct, which means scientists do not expect another eruption.

questions.prompt: What is melted rock called while it is still underground?
questions.explanation: The passage says melted rock under the ground is magma. It is called lava only after it reaches the surface.

questions.prompt: Why might a quiet volcano still need to be watched?

choices.text: Every quiet mountain erupts every day
Ash always falls from a blue sky
Experts only watch volcanoes that are extinct
Dormant means sleeping, not gone, and tools can spot warning clues

questions.explanation: The passage separates sleeping from gone, and it says shaking, gases, and ground changes can warn a town. A quiet volcano can still deserve watching.
